relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-α could cause the TRPC1 expression which medicated increased Ca2+ entry through SOCE, representing an important mechanism of endothelial injury through TRPC1

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: VEGF bound with VEGFR2 which activated heterologously co-expressed TRPC3/6 channels, such as the style of VEGFR2-TRPC3 and VEGFR2-TRPC6 on cells

relationships.subject: TRPC1
relationships.evidence_quote: The concentration of intracellular calcium ion promoted with the increased opening of TRPC1 on ECs, which accelerated the formation of actin stress fibers and enhanced the stretching and deforming ability of ECs, thus leading to increased permeability

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Recent studies manifested that electroacupuncture reduced joint pain by interacting with TRPV1 (176).

key_findings: Review: TRP channels (TRPC1/6, TRPM2, TRPM7) mediate Ca2+ signals driving endothelial permeability, neutrophil migration/NETs and PAD activity in RA
TRPV1 and TRPA1 are preclinical analgesic targets in arthritis pain
